scope: cross-infrastructure quorum with two external providers plus independent local runtime

provider_failure.scenario: C unavailable; A and B remain valid ACCEPT

provider_collusion_simulation.scenario: A and B collude and emit internally valid but false observations; C is honest/conflicting
provider_collusion_simulation.security_boundary: A 2-of-3 quorum cannot detect collusion of two members without an additional independent trust/observation layer

tamper.scenario: mutate A observed payload without changing receipt hash

gate_policy: Capability unlock requires a valid 2-of-3 quorum; integrity or replay failure fails closed.
note: A and B are independent provider infrastructures (Vercel and GitHub Actions); C is a separate local runtime. A third independent cloud provider was not available through the current connected zero-cost execution surface, so this artifact does not claim three independent cloud providers.
